'''Wakamiya Inari Shrine''' (若宮稲荷神社) is the name of several {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrines|1=Shinto shrine}}.

* {{ill|Wakamiya Inari Shrine (Kazamaura)|ja|若宮稲荷神社 (風間浦村)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wakamiya Inari Shrine (Kazamaura)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Kazamaura, Shimokita District, Aomori Prefecture, at Shimonofuro, Yunoue.
* {{ill|Wakamiya Inari Shrine (Nakadomari)|ja|若宮稲荷神社 (中泊町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wakamiya Inari Shrine (Nakadomari)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Nakadomari, Kitatsugaru District, Aomori Prefecture, at Tamogi, Wakamiya.
* {{ill|Wakamiya Inari Shrine (Izumo)|ja|若宮稲荷神社 (出雲市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wakamiya Inari Shrine (Izumo)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Izumo City, Shimane Prefecture, in Takamatsu Town.
* {{ill|Wakamiya Inari Shrine (Nagasaki)|ja|若宮稲荷神社 (長崎市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wakamiya Inari Shrine (Nagasaki)|1=Wakamiya Inari Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q116450100}} - Located in Nagasaki City, Nagasaki Prefecture, in Irabayashi. Also known as Irabayashi Inari Shrine, it is renowned for the {{ill|Takengei|en|Takengei|qid=Q11598643|lt=Takengei|1=Takengei}} performance.
* {{ill|Wakamiya Inari Shrine|en|Wakamiya Inari Shrine|qid=Q7960795|lt=Wakamiya Inari Shrine|1=Wakamiya Inari Shrine}} - Located in Waipahu, Hawaii, United States.
